name: ST-away-passed-over
old: for (const boat of state.AllBoats) for (const a of boatAnimators(boat)) a.update(d);
new: for (const boat of state.AllBoats) if (boat.GameObject.activeInHierarchy) for (const a of boatAnimators(boat)) a.update(d);

name: ST-hidden-passed-over
new: if (!hide) for (const a of boatAnimators(s.boat)) a.update(dt);

name: ST-hidden-walked
new: for (const a of [...s.boat.GameObject.walk()].flatMap((n) => n.getComponents('Animator').map((c) => c.animator).filter(Boolean))) a.update(dt);

name: ST-naval-hud-door
old: if (!model || covered) { drawNavalHud(model, { dt: gamePaused() ? 0 : dt, covered }); return; }

name: ST-naval-hud-clock
old: if (!model || covered) { drawNavalHud(model, { dt: gamePaused() ? 0 : dt, covered }); return; }

name: ST-helm-door
old: if (!helm && !ab) { drawEnhancedHelm({ helm: null, aboard: null }, csaHelmHooks); return; }
